card.name: The word per before cent
card.fires_on: The word "per" right after a number when it begins the British-style "per cent" (e.g. "80 per cent"). It appears in news and report text giving percentages.

modes.label: Number then per cent
modes.description: "per" directly after a figure, with "cent" expected next.
modes.example: KENYA COULD end up losing 80<< per>> cent of its wildlife species in protected areas

card.writes: It suppresses percent-sign tokens like % and %%, since the word "cent" is due next instead of a symbol.
card.plain: It spots the "per" in "per cent" after a number, as in "18 per cent".
